title: Outwitting Ed Fox on the first job
summary: The band memorizes its book and hides the music at the Ritz, so Fox's police find no music to confiscate at the first dance.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: We rehearsed that band every day, every day, every day. So now our first job was going to be -- was at the Metropolitan Life funeral place there, on South Parkway.

That's right. And so we knew see, we were beginning to think in these days a little bit now, we knew that Ed Foxx was going to try to cause some trouble. So in the meantime we had memorized a book, we had rehearsed so much that we memorized the book and we had the music locked up at the Ritz Hotel. So when we played this dance that night, Ed Foxx had sent the police up there to take all of the music. Now, Walter Fuller and the others all that split, they didn't have any music, see. We were hip enough to get that music and hide it so when we came up there and was playing, and they thought they
were going to find some music on the stand so they could confiscate it, we were up there with no music playing the repertoire.
So Fox, because he figured like Earl worked for him, and he was going to pull that 'tech' any time you worked for a guy, whatever you do it belongs to him --

And he was going to try and take that music and give it to the other band, you see. But any way we tricked him there, so after we had saved up all of these deposits and what not to go out on the road and meet our obligations, we were then able to rent a bus.
